title_en: Notice of the Supreme People's Court on Issuing the Implementation Measures (for Trial Implementation) on Establishing Integrity Supervisors in the Trial and Enforcement Departments of People's Courts
full_text_en:
Supreme People's Court

Notice on Issuing the Implementation Measures for Establishing Integrity Supervisors in Trial and Enforcement Departments of People's Courts (Trial)

Fa Fa [2009] No. 8

To: All High People's Courts of provinces, autonomous regions, and municipalities directly under the Central Government; the Military Court of the People's Liberation Army; the Production and Construction Corps Branch of the High People's Court of Xinjiang Uygur Autonomous Region

The Implementation Measures for Establishing Integrity Supervisors in Trial and Enforcement Departments of People's Courts (Trial) are hereby issued to you for earnest implementation.

February 20, 2009

Implementation Measures for Establishing Integrity Supervisors in Trial and Enforcement Departments of People's Courts (Trial)

Article 1 These Measures are formulated in accordance with the Judges Law of the People's Republic of China, the Regulations on Supervision Work of People's Courts, and other relevant provisions, in order to strengthen routine supervision over the discipline and conduct of personnel in trial and enforcement work, promote judicial integrity, and safeguard judicial justice.

Article 2 People's courts shall establish integrity supervisors in trial and enforcement departments. Integrity supervisors shall generally be senior judges holding a non-leading position at the corresponding level of principal or deputy principal, or may also be concurrently held by the deputy head of the department.

Article 3 Integrity supervisors shall carry out their work under the dual leadership of the principal responsible person of their department and the supervision department of the court, with the leadership of the principal responsible person of the department being primary.

Article 4 Integrity supervisors shall perform the following duties:

(1) Assist the principal responsible person of their department in analyzing the anti-corruption and integrity-building situation of the department, and organize the implementation of anti-corruption and integrity-building work tasks;

(2) Assist the principal responsible person of their department in supervising and inspecting the compliance of department personnel with laws, regulations, discipline, and various rules and systems;

(3) Assist the principal responsible person of their department in understanding and grasping the ideological dynamics of department personnel, and conduct education on professional ethics, discipline and conduct, and clean judicial practice for department personnel;

(4) Assist the principal responsible person of their department in improving and perfecting the integrity system of the department;

(5) Assist the supervision department of the court in receiving reports from the public on issues of discipline and conduct of the department and its personnel;

(6) Provide integrity guidance and integrity consultation to department personnel, and promptly give reminders regarding emerging or tendentious issues in discipline and conduct among department personnel;

(7) Complete other anti-corruption and integrity-building work tasks assigned by the principal responsible person of the department or the supervision department of the court.

Article 5 In addition to performing the duties specified in Article 4 of these Measures, integrity supervisors may also concurrently serve as deputy secretary of the Party branch, political assistant, or other positions in the department, concurrently manage the ideological and political work of the department, and enjoy the same work treatment as the deputy head of the department.

Article 6 Integrity supervisors may adopt the following supervision methods based on the needs of supervision work:

(1) Attend department meetings such as division (bureau) affairs meetings convened by the department;

(2) With the consent of the principal responsible person of the department or the supervision department of the court, consult relevant case files, documents, and materials;

(3) Assist relevant departments of the court or arrange for case evaluation and other work in accordance with the arrangements of the principal responsible person of the department;

(4) In accordance with the arrangements of the principal responsible person of the department or the supervision department of the court, listen to opinions and feedback from case parties and other relevant persons, and inquire about circumstances from case parties and other relevant persons;

(5) With the consent of the principal responsible person of the department or the supervision department of the court, require department staff to provide explanations or clarifications on relevant issues;

(6) Other supervision methods prescribed by laws, regulations, and the rules and systems of the people's courts.

Article 7 When organizational and personnel departments evaluate cadres in trial and enforcement departments, they shall listen to the opinions of the integrity supervisor of the department.

Article 8 Integrity supervisors shall, based on the actual conditions of their department, make suggestions to the principal responsible person of the department or the supervision department of the court on strengthening integrity construction and improving work style.

Article 9 Where an integrity supervisor discovers problems of discipline or conduct in the department, he or she shall report to the principal responsible person of the department and propose corrective suggestions. If the suggestions are not adopted, he or she may also directly report to the supervision department of the court.

Where an integrity supervisor considers that the discovered problems are suspected of violating discipline and require investigation of disciplinary responsibility, he or she shall promptly report to the supervision department of the court while reporting to the principal responsible person of the department.

Article 10 The supervision department of a people's court may, based on work needs, mobilize integrity supervisors to assist or participate in the preliminary verification, investigation, and adjudication of disciplinary violation cases.

Article 11 The supervision department of a people's court shall convene regular meetings of integrity supervisors to deploy, guide, and inspect the work of integrity supervisors, and organize activities such as business training and work exchanges for integrity supervisors.

Article 12 Integrity supervisors must be devoted to their duties, act impartially, abide by discipline and law, maintain confidentiality, and shall not seek personal gain by abusing their power, nor shall they abuse their power to interfere with trial organizations and trial and enforcement personnel in lawfully handling cases.

If an integrity supervisor abuses his or her power, or if serious illegal or criminal problems occur in the department due to his or her failure to seriously perform duties, responsibility shall be pursued in accordance with relevant provisions.

Article 13 The appointment, removal, transfer, rewards, and punishments of integrity supervisors shall be subject to prior consultation with the supervision department.

Full-time integrity supervisors shall generally not be selected from within the same department, and shall be rotated on an irregular basis.

Article 14 Integrity supervisors shall report annually on their performance of integrity supervisor duties to the principal responsible person of their department and the supervision department of the court.

The annual assessment grade of an integrity supervisor shall be determined after seeking the opinion of the supervision department of the court.

Article 15 People's courts may, by reference to these Provisions, establish integrity supervisors in departments other than trial and enforcement departments.

Article 16 These Measures shall be interpreted by the Supreme People's Court.

Article 17 These Measures shall come into effect on the date of issuance.
